Welcome to our love story

Every love story has a beginning, but some stories become memories that last forever.

Welcome to the beautiful world of Mursith and Farsana — a place where love lives in every photograph, happiness shines through every smile, and precious moments become timeless memories.

On 13 August 2021, we began a beautiful new chapter of our lives. It was more than a wedding day; it was the beginning of a journey built on love, trust, commitment, and togetherness.

Every love story has a beginning, but some stories become memories that last forever.

The beginning of forever

Some moments become special because of what happens, while others become unforgettable because of what they mean.

Our wedding marked the beginning of a new journey, a journey in which two hearts came together to share dreams, happiness, responsibilities, and the beautiful experiences of life.

On 13 August 2021, Mursith and Farsana celebrated one of the most meaningful chapters of their lives. Surrounded by love, happiness, and cherished memories, we took our first steps into a future together.

One special day brought countless memories. One beautiful beginning gave us a story to cherish forever.

Our promise of forever

Forever is not simply a word. It is the hope of sharing countless ordinary days and extraordinary moments together.

It is finding happiness in the little things, offering kindness during difficult times, celebrating each other's dreams, and continuing to create beautiful memories along the way.

Our wedding day was the beginning of a special chapter, but the meaning of our story lives in the journey beyond that day.

Every photograph reminds us of a moment we experienced. Every memory connects us to the happiness we shared. Every passing year adds new pages to a story that continues to unfold.

Our wedding was a beautiful day. Our memories are treasures. Our journey is a story that continues.

Our greatest blessing

Ayzel Maryam — some love stories become even more beautiful with the arrival of a little miracle.

On our journey of love, Mursith and Farsana were blessed with their precious baby girl, Ayzel Maryam — a little heart who brought a new kind of happiness, endless love, and countless reasons to smile into their lives.
